pages.name: Dutch: Leningrad, 4.Nf3 Bg7
pages.notes: Plan 3 played ...Qe8-h5 with the king on e8 and through g6; plans 1 and 2 were generic (...h6 and ...g5, 'weaknesses on the long diagonal'). Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Leningrad, 4.Nf3 Bg7 5.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 2 relied on ...Qh5 (blocked by g6) and ...h5-h4. Rewrote plan 2 around ...Ne4 and ...Qe8-f7; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch Defense: Leningrad Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 played ...Qe8-h5 with the king on e8 and through g6. Rewrote plans 1 and 2 (adding White's d4-d5 and e2-e4 choices); British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Leningrad, Main Line, 7.d5 c5
pages.notes: Plan 3 read d4 as a move; plan 4 used a 'semi-open' f-file that holds Black's f5-pawn. Rewrote plans 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Leningrad, Main Line, 7.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed a knight through c7, where the c-pawn stands. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Leningrad, Main Line, 7.Nc3 Qe8 8.Nd5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had cxd5 before any exchange and a passed-pawn claim; the overview missed the Nxc7 fork threat. Rewrote overview and plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Leningrad, Main Line, 7.Nc3 c6 8.d5 e5
pages.notes: The overview missed 9.dxe6 en passant; plan 3 sent pieces to c4 and b5 (own pawn on c4, b5 covered by c6); plan 4 put White's e2-e4 in Black's plan. Rewrote overview and plans 3-4 (reviewer: plan 3 rejected once, revised, re-accepted).

pages.name: Dutch: Leningrad, Main Line, 7.Nc3 c6 8.d5 e5 9.dxe6 Bxe6 10.Qd3
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Rb1-b4 through the b2-pawn; the overview was generic. Rewrote overview and plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Leningrad, Main Line, 7.Nc3 c6 8.d5 Qe8
pages.notes: Plan 1 swung the queen from e8 to h5 through g6; plan 2 had dxe6 before ...e5. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Leningrad, Main Line, 7.Nc3 c6 8.Re1
pages.notes: Plan 3 put White's e4 push into Black's plan; plan 4 sent the queen to h5 through g6; plan 2 was vague. Rewrote plans 2-4 (reviewer: plan 4 rejected once for claiming Qe8 controls e4, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.
